Rashi on Rosh Hashanah 7a:10:1.english: First with respect to its own matter - Meaning, with respect to the act of Haman.

Rashi on Rosh Hashanah 7a:11:1.hebrew: ותנא דידן - דלא תנא במתני' ר"ה לחדשים:
Rashi on Rosh Hashanah 7a:11:1.english: And our Tanna - who did not teach in the Mishnah "the New Year for months."

Rashi on Rosh Hashanah 7a:12:1.hebrew: עיבורים מניסן מנינן - בתמיה, וכי רשאין ב"ד לישב ולעיין בצרכי עיבור ר"ה בניסן:
Rashi on Rosh Hashanah 7a:12:1.english: Do we count intercalations from Nisan? - [This is asked] in astonishment: Is the court permitted to sit and deliberate about the needs of the intercalation of Rosh Hashanah in Nisan?

Rashi on Rosh Hashanah 7a:12:2.hebrew: אין מעברין - אין מעיינין בצורכי צבור להודיע לגולה שעיברו בית דין את השנה, שלא ישתכח הדבר עד אדר הבא:
Rashi on Rosh Hashanah 7a:12:2.english: We do not intercalate - We do not examine the needs of the public [for intercalation] in order to notify the Diaspora that the court has intercalated the year, so that the matter not be forgotten before the next Adar.

Rashi on Rosh Hashanah 7a:12:3.hebrew: אבל מפני הדחק - שמפחידין שלא יגזרו נכרים מלישב ב"ד, או שצריך הנשיא לחצר המלך, ואין מעברין אא"כ ירצה נשיא, כדאמר בסנהדרין (דף יא.):
Rashi on Rosh Hashanah 7a:12:3.english: But because of pressing circumstances - For they are afraid that the gentiles will decree against [the Jews] sitting [as] a court, or that the Nasi is needed at the king's court. And we do not intercalate unless the Nasi consents, as stated in Sanhedrin (11a).

Rashi on Rosh Hashanah 7a:12:4.hebrew: ואעפ"כ אין מעברין אלא אדר - אין מוסיפין חדש על השנה אלא אדר, דכתיב שמור את חדש האביב — חדש הסמוך לאביב עבר, שיבוא אביב בזמנו:
Rashi on Rosh Hashanah 7a:12:4.english: And even so, we only intercalate Adar - We add a month to the year only [in the form of a second] Adar, as it is written: "Observe the month of Aviv" — [meaning] the month adjacent to Aviv [spring], intercalate it, so that spring will come at its proper time.

Rashi on Rosh Hashanah 7a:13:1.hebrew: הפסקת עיבורין - שכיון שקדשו את החדש לשם ניסן, פסקה שנה שעברה מלהיות מעוברת עוד, שאין רשאין לעשות ניסן אדר, שכבר נכנסה שנה אחרת לענין עיבור:
Rashi on Rosh Hashanah 7a:13:1.english: The cessation of intercalations - For once they have sanctified the month as Nisan, the past year ceases from being intercalated any longer, since they are not permitted to make Nisan into [a second] Adar, because a different year has already begun with regard to intercalation.

Rashi on Rosh Hashanah 7a:13:2.english: They testified - Rabbi Yehoshua and Rabbi Papias [testified] that they intercalate the year throughout [the month of] Adar: if the court saw after Purim that the year needs to be intercalated, they intercalate it.

Rashi on Rosh Hashanah 7a:13:3.hebrew: שהיו אומרים עד הפורים - לפי שהיו חכמים אומרים שאין מעברין אא"כ נתישבו בדבר לפני הפורים, לכך הוזקקו לעדות זו:
Rashi on Rosh Hashanah 7a:13:3.english: That they would say until Purim - Because the Sages used to say that one may not intercalate [the year] unless they had settled the matter before Purim, therefore they were compelled [to rely] on this testimony.

Rashi on Rosh Hashanah 7a:14:1.hebrew: אתי לזלזולי בחמץ - שכבר מן הפורים ואילך התחילו הדרשנים לדרוש ברבים בהלכו' הפסח, הוזקקו השומעים לעשות פסח לסוף ל' יום. ואם יעברו ב"ד את השנה, לא יתקבלו דברי שלוחי ב"ד לשומעין לדחות את הפסח, שכבר שמעו מן הדרשני':
Rashi on Rosh Hashanah 7a:14:1.english: He would come to treat chametz lightly - For from Purim onward the preachers began to expound publicly the laws of Pesach, [and] the listeners became bound to make the Pesach offering at the end of thirty days. And if the court were to intercalate the year, the words of the court's messengers to the listeners, [telling them] to postpone Pesach, would not be accepted, since they had already heard [otherwise] from the preachers.

Rashi on Rosh Hashanah 7a:16:1.hebrew: בהפסקה לא קא מיירי - בראשי שנים דהפסקה לא קא מיירי:
Rashi on Rosh Hashanah 7a:16:1.english: With regard to a cessation, [our Mishnah] is not speaking - With regard to the New Years of [the counting of] years, in which a cessation is [relevant], [our Mishnah] is not speaking.

Rashi on Rosh Hashanah 7a:17:1.hebrew: חדש בחדשו לחדשי - חדשי יתירא לדרשה:
Rashi on Rosh Hashanah 7a:17:1.english: "From month to month" [lit., "a month in its month," lechodshei] - The word "chodshei" is superfluous, [and is available] for the exposition.

Rashi on Rosh Hashanah 7a:1:1.hebrew: בעל מום - שנולד במומו ועומד לישחט בחוץ, מיום שנולד הוא ראוי לכך, ומונין לו משנולד:
Rashi on Rosh Hashanah 7a:1:1.english: A blemished animal - [An animal] that was born with its blemish and is destined to be slaughtered outside [the Temple]; from the day it was born it is fit for this, and we count [its year] for it from its birth.

Rashi on Rosh Hashanah 7a:2:1.hebrew: מי מצי אכיל ליה - ביום שנולד? דלמא נפל הוה, ואין שחיטה מטהרתו עד שישהה שמונה ימים, דשוב נפק ליה מכלל נפל. דתניא (שבת ד' קלה:) רשב"ג אומר: כל ששהה שלשים יום באדם — אינו נפל, ובבהמה — שמונה ימים:
Rashi on Rosh Hashanah 7a:2:1.english: Can he eat it - on the day it was born? Perhaps it was a stillborn/non-viable [animal] (nefel), and slaughter does not purify it [from impurity] until it survives eight days, for then it has left the category of non-viable. For it was taught (Shabbat 135b): Rabban Shimon ben Gamliel says: Any [infant] that survived thirty days among humans is not a non-viable newborn (nefel), and among animals, eight days.

Rashi on Rosh Hashanah 7a:3:1.english: For months - For the counting of the months of the year.

Rashi on Rosh Hashanah 7a:3:2.hebrew: לעיבורין - קא ס"ד לישב ב"ד ולעיין אם השנה הבאה צריכה להתעבר:
Rashi on Rosh Hashanah 7a:3:2.english: For intercalations - It enters [the mind] to [say that the court] sits and examines whether the coming year needs to be intercalated.

Rashi on Rosh Hashanah 7a:3:3.hebrew: ולתרומת שקלים - להקריב ראשון קרבנות הלקוחים מתרומת קופות של שקלי שנה זו:
Rashi on Rosh Hashanah 7a:3:3.english: And for the collection of the shekels - To offer first the sacrifices that are purchased from the collection of the [Temple] chests of the shekels of this year.

Rashi on Rosh Hashanah 7a:3:4.hebrew: אף לשכירות בתים - המשכיר בית לחבירו ואמר לשנה זו, כלתה שנתו באחד בניסן, ואפי' לא דר בו אלא חודש אחד:
Rashi on Rosh Hashanah 7a:3:4.english: Also for the rental of houses - One who rents a house to his fellow and says [that he is renting it] for this year: his year ends on the first of Nisan, even if [the tenant] lived in it for only one month.

Rashi on Rosh Hashanah 7a:4:1.hebrew: החדש הזה לכם - ומנלן דניסן? דכתיב "ויקחו להם שה לפסח", וכתיב קרא אחרינא, שהפסח בחדש האביב, שיש בו אביב, שהתבואה בכירה בו להיות מבושלת בגמר בישולה:
Rashi on Rosh Hashanah 7a:4:1.english: "This month shall be to you" - And how do we know that [this refers to] Nisan? For it is written, "and they shall take for themselves a lamb for the Passover," and another verse states that Passover is in the month of Aviv — a month in which there is aviv, for the grain ripens early in it, reaching the completion of its ripening.

Rashi on Rosh Hashanah 7a:5:1.hebrew: בעינא אביב וליכא - שכבר נגמרה מניסן, ואי איכא זרעא אפילה, אין זה בכיר אלא אפיל:
Rashi on Rosh Hashanah 7a:5:1.english: I require aviv, and there is none - For [the ripening] has already been completed by Nisan; and if there is any late-growing seed [in Iyar], this is not early-ripening [grain] but late-ripening.

Rashi on Rosh Hashanah 7a:5:2.hebrew: ואימא אדר - דאיכא זרעא חרפא, המתבכר מאדר:
Rashi on Rosh Hashanah 7a:5:2.english: And say [that it is] Adar - For there is the early-ripening winter crop, which ripens early, from Adar.

Rashi on Rosh Hashanah 7a:5:3.hebrew: רוב אביב - שיהו רוב תבואות מתבכרות בו:
Rashi on Rosh Hashanah 7a:5:3.english: Most of it is aviv - That most of the grain crops ripen early in it.

Rashi on Rosh Hashanah 7a:6:1.hebrew: שיש בו אסיפה - שמכניסין בו פירות לבית מפני הגשמים, וכל הקיץ הן עשויות גדישין לייבש:
Rashi on Rosh Hashanah 7a:6:1.english: For it has gathering - For in it they bring the produce into the house because of the rains, and throughout the entire summer it is made into stacks to dry.

Tosafot on Rosh Hashanah 7a:11:1.hebrew: בשנים קא מיירי - וקשיא, דהא קא אמר "לרגלים", ואמר לעיל: "כיון שעברה עליו שנה בלא רגלים, ורגלים בלא שנה". י"ל: מכל מקום בחדשים לא קא מיירי:
Tosafot on Rosh Hashanah 7a:11:1.english: It is speaking of years - And this is difficult, for [the Mishnah] says "for the festivals," and [the Gemara] said above: "Once a year has passed over him without festivals, or festivals without a year [he transgresses]." One can answer: In any case, [the Tanna] is not speaking of months.

Tosafot on Rosh Hashanah 7a:13:1.hebrew: הם העידו - משנה היא בעדיות (פ"ז משנה ז), ופ"ק דסנהדרין (ד' יב: ושם), גבי עברוה ביום ל' של אדר, דאמר רב נחמן: מעובר וקדוש. ומקשי ליה רבא: מכדי מפורים לפסח תלתין יומין הוי, ומפורים דרשינן בהלכות הפסח, וכי מטי ריש ירחא ומרחקים להו אתי לזלזולי? ה"נ ה"מ לאקשויי אמתניתין דעדיות:
Tosafot on Rosh Hashanah 7a:13:1.english: "They testified" - It is a Mishnah in Eduyot (7:7), and in the first chapter of Sanhedrin (12b, and there), regarding [the case where] they intercalated it on the thirtieth day of Adar, for Rav Nachman said: It is intercalated and sanctified. And Rava challenges him: Since from Purim to Passover is thirty days, and from Purim we expound the laws of Passover, then when the new month arrives and they push them off, will they come to treat [the festival] lightly? Likewise, here too, [Rava] could have challenged [Rav Nachman] from the Mishnah in Eduyot.

Tosafot on Rosh Hashanah 7a:16:1.hebrew: בהפסקה לא קא מיירי - לקמן (ראש השנה ד' יב.) גבי אחד בתשרי ר"ה לירקות, ולא קתני לנדרים כדקתני בברייתא, משום דמתניתין בהפסקה לא קא מיירי:
Tosafot on Rosh Hashanah 7a:16:1.english: It is not speaking of an interruption - Below (Rosh Hashanah 12a), regarding "the first of Tishrei is the New Year for vegetables [i.e., tithes of vegetables]," [the Mishnah] does not teach "for vows," as the Baraita teaches, because the Mishnah is not speaking of an interruption.

Tosafot on Rosh Hashanah 7a:18:1.english: "From the beginning of the year" - Below (Rosh Hashanah 8a) we say that this ["beginning of the year"] is Tishrei:

Tosafot on Rosh Hashanah 7a:1:1.hebrew: הא בבעל מום - בעל מום מעיקרו דתם ונעשה בעל מום, כיון דלא חזי לאכילה מונים לו משעת הרצאה. ואין לדקדק מכאן שיהיה שייך בל תאחר בנתינה לכהן, דהכא לענין להאכילו בתוך שנתו דצריך, כדאיתא פרק [עד כמה] (בכורות דף כו:):
Tosafot on Rosh Hashanah 7a:1:1.english: "This applies to a blemished animal" - [This refers to] a blemished animal that was originally unblemished and then became blemished. Since it is not fit for eating, they count [its year] from the time of its dedication (haratza'ah). And one should not infer from here that the prohibition of "you shall not delay" would apply to giving it to the priest, for here [the matter] concerns feeding it [to the priest] within its year, which is required, as stated in the chapter ["Ad Kamah"] (Bekhorot 26b):

Tosafot on Rosh Hashanah 7a:21:1.hebrew: שמא לא ימסרם יפה יפה - פלוגתא דתנאי היא בסוף פרק הבית והעליה (ב"מ ד' קיח.) גבי שומרי ספיחים בשביעית, אי מתנדב שומר חנם. וקצת תימה דפריך הכא "פשיטא" במילתא דהויא פלוגתא דתנאי. ושמא יש לחלק, דהכא ליכא למיחש כולי האי כמו בשומר:
Tosafot on Rosh Hashanah 7a:21:1.english: "Lest he not hand them over properly" - This is a dispute among the Tannaim at the end of the chapter "HaBayit VeHaAliyah" (Bava Metzia 118a), regarding those who guard aftergrowths in the Sabbatical year: whether one who volunteers [to do so] is [considered] an unpaid guardian. And it is somewhat surprising that [the Gemara] asks here "it is obvious!" about a matter that is a dispute among the Tannaim. Perhaps one can distinguish: here there is not as much reason for concern as there is with a guardian:

Tosafot on Rosh Hashanah 7a:8:1.hebrew: מדברי קבלה למדנו - לא מצי למילף מכאן מינייהו כלל, אם לא נאמר שהיתה קבלה בידם סדר שמות החדשים זה אחר זה. והכי אמר בירושלמי: שמות החדשים עלו בידם מבבל. בראשונה — "בירח האיתנים", שבו נולדו אבות; "בירח בול", שבו כל העולם נובל, והארץ עשויה בולות בולות, שבו בולים לבהמה בבתיהם; "בירח זיו", שבו זיו האילנות. מכאן ואילך: "ויהי בחדש ניסן שנת עשרים", "ויהי בחדש כסלו שנת עשרים", "בחדש העשירי הוא חדש טבת":
Tosafot on Rosh Hashanah 7a:8:1.english: "From the words of the Kabbalah (Prophets and Writings) we have learned" - [The Gemara] could not derive anything at all from these [verses] about [the months], unless we say that they had a tradition [regarding] the order of the names of the months, one after the other. And so it says in the Yerushalmi: The names of the months came up with them from Babylonia. At first [the months were called]: "the month of Ethanim" (1 Kings 8:2), in which the Patriarchs were born; "the month of Bul" (1 Kings 6:38), in which the whole world withers (novel), and the earth is made into heaps (bulot), [and] in which fodder is mixed (bulim) for the animals in their houses; "the month of Ziv" (1 Kings 6:1), in which is the splendor (ziv) of the trees. From here on: "And it was in the month of Nisan, in the twentieth year" (Nehemiah 2:1); "And it was in the month of Kislev, in the twentieth year" (Nehemiah 1:1); "in the tenth month, which is the month of Tevet" (Esther 2:16).
